title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 5:17-20
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 5:17-20</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="17" /> Don’t suppose that I have come to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">do away with</char> the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red" word-lang="greek" word-original="νόμος">Torah  </char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">or the Prophets</char>. 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        I have not come to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">do away with</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        but to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="πληρόω">fill them full  </char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="18" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">Because</char>, truly, I tell you: 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">until</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the sky</char> and the land pass on, 
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
        not one dot or one squiggle will pass on from the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">Torah</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">until</char> all things have taken place. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
        <verse number="19" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">Therefore</char>, whoever <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">undoes</char> one of the least of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">these commands</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        and then they teach people to do this, 
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
        that person will be called least in <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the kingdom of the skies</char>. 
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        And whoever does [<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">these commands</char> ], 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
        and then teaches [people to do this],
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c'">
        this person will be called great in <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the kingdom of the skies</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="20" /> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">Because</char>, truly, I tell you: 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        unless your <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">doing-of-what-is-right</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="περισσεύω">far surpasses  </char>
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        that of the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">Scribes</char> and <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">Pharisaions</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        you won’t be entering into <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the kingdom of the skies</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
